mapper.select: SELECT id, name, parent_id, sort_order, level, created_at, updated_at FROM category ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}

WITH RECURSIVE chain AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM category WHERE id = #{startId} UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, chain.depth + 1 FROM chain JOIN category p ON p.id = chain.parent_id WHERE chain.depth < #{maxDepth} ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chain WHERE chain.id = #{ancestorId})
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT id, level, 0 AS depth FROM category WHERE id = #{rootId} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, subtree.level + 1, subtree.depth + 1 FROM category c JOIN subtree ON subtree.id = c.parent_id WHERE subtree.depth < #{maxDepth} ) UPDATE category SET level = subtree.level FROM subtree WHERE category.id = subtree.id AND category.level IS DISTINCT FROM subtree.level
